known_limitations: DEV gain threshold failed; HOLDOUT sealed and candidate not promoted.
Human annotation/adjudication, heterogeneous judge and preference-bias validation are incomplete.
Runtime structural stop checks do not cover every natural-language approval misstatement; this is a protocol deviation.
Trial-level Jeffreys intervals do not adjust within-group dependence and are descriptive only. Main inference resamples source groups.
fee_basis: Complete supplier usage multiplied by frozen peak CNY prices; not reconciled supplier invoice.
